summary_rationale: International Gemological Institute (India) Limited operates a capital-light, high-switching-cost certification tollbooth embedded inside the world's largest diamond cutting and polishing hubs in Surat and Mumbai. Following the December 2024 global consolidation of IGI Belgium and IGI Netherlands and the February 2026 acquisition of AGL, IGIL combines 61% operating margins, 94% pre-tax CFO/EBITDA conversion, negligible debt, and 69.2% ROCE with accelerating +31% YoY revenue growth in Q2 FY27 aided by GIA's October 2025 exit from granular lab-grown diamond letter grading. Operational KPIs are strong across volume (+26% YoY), LGD mix, and margin expansion, earning PASS_WITH_WATCH solely to monitor B2B debtor days (66 days in 15M FY26), LGD wholesale price deflation, and Blackstone's 76.55% promoter overhang.
